title: Split sequence indices within each class
description: You shuffle class-specific indices and use the returned lists to select sequences and labels.

steps.description: You create a seeded generator, identify classes, and prepare separate index lists. The helper works with labels rather than copying sequence data.
You shuffle each class's indices and compute its test count with floor. The first slice enters test_idx, and the remaining slice enters train_idx.

steps.question: How do the selected sequences stay paired with their labels?
steps.answer: Each split uses the same index array for its sequence selection and label selection.

steps.description: You build the training and test collections, then request their lengths with print. The supplied trace excerpt contains no final counts.
